description_en: Queries the free trial information of a specified OSS bucket or NAS file system
description_zh: 查询指定OSS Bucket或NAS文件系统的免费试用信息
kebab_example: aliyun hbr get-trial-info --source-type OSS --bucket hbr-backup-oss --file-system-id 005494 --create-time 1607436917 --region cn-hangzhou
name: GetTrialInfo

parameters.help_en: The data source type. Only free trial information of OSS backup and NAS backup can be queried
parameters.help_zh: 数据源类型。仅支持查询OSS备份和NAS备份的免费试用信息
parameters.name: source_type

parameters.help_en: This parameter is required only when SourceType is set to OSS. The name of the OSS bucket
parameters.help_zh: 仅当SourceType取值为OSS时，需要配置该参数。表示OSS bucket名称
parameters.name: bucket

parameters.help_en: This parameter is required only when SourceType is set to NAS. The ID of the file system
parameters.help_zh: 仅当SourceType取值为NAS时，需要配置该参数。表示文件系统ID
parameters.name: file_system_id

parameters.help_en: This parameter is required only when SourceType is set to NAS. The time when the file system was created. UNIX timestamp, in seconds
parameters.help_zh: 仅当SourceType取值为NAS时，需要配置该参数。表示文件系统创建时间。UNIX时间，单位为秒
parameters.name: create_time

Code.description_en: The return code. A value of 200 indicates success

Message.description_en: The returned message. The value "successful" is returned on success. An error message is returned on failure
Message.description_zh: 返回信息描述，成功一般返回successful，错误时会返回相应错误信息

Success.description_en:
Indicates whether the request was successful.

true: The request was successful.
false: The request failed
Success.description_zh:
请求是否成功。

true：成功。
false：失败

TrialInfo.description_en: The free trial properties. This parameter is returned only when a free trial record exists for the data source
TrialInfo.description_zh: 免费试用属性。仅当该数据源存在免费试用记录时返回

KeepAfterTrialExpiration.description_en: Indicates whether the service is converted to pay-as-you-go after the free trial expires
KeepAfterTrialExpiration.description_zh: 免费试用结束后是否转为按量付费

TrialBackupPlanQuota.description_en: The remaining number of free trial backup plans that can be created. The value 1 is returned if the free trial has not expired and no free trial backup plan has been created. Otherwise, the value 0 is returned
TrialBackupPlanQuota.description_zh: 剩余可创建的免费试用备份计划数量。免费试用未到期且尚未创建免费试用备份计划时返回1，否则返回0

TrialExpireTime.description_en: The expiration time of the free trial. UNIX timestamp, in seconds
TrialExpireTime.description_zh: 免费试用过期时间。Unix时间戳，单位为秒

TrialStartTime.description_en: The start time of the free trial. UNIX timestamp, in seconds
TrialStartTime.description_zh: 免费试用开始时间。Unix时间戳，单位为秒

TrialVaultQuota.description_en: The remaining number of free trial backup vaults that can be created. The value 1 is returned if the free trial has not expired and no free trial backup vault has been created. Otherwise, the value 0 is returned
TrialVaultQuota.description_zh: 剩余可创建的免费试用备份库数量。免费试用未到期且尚未创建免费试用备份库时返回1，否则返回0

TrialVaultReleaseTime.description_en: The release time of the free trial backup vault. UNIX timestamp, in seconds
TrialVaultReleaseTime.description_zh: 免费试用仓库释放时间。Unix时间戳，单位为秒
